subject: Problem replicating model from Blandiardo text

messages.author: 03bc4090a2c2b3fb
messages.subject: Problem replicating model from Blandiardo text
parts:
Hello,

I am using the Blangiardo text "Spatial and Spatio-temporal Bayesian Models with R-INLA", among other sources, to teach basic INLA syntax for different model types to my colleagues. However, I am running into a strange error in trying to replicate the SPDE space-time model for the Piemonte air pollution data. The verbose = T output gets cut off because it's so long, but I have attached all that I could extract, along with the code I was running. I appreciate any help you can provide for this - I have run the code from this section of the book in the past without incident.

For reference, I am running INLA_23.04.24 on R version 4.2.2, in RStudio 2023.06.0 on a Windows 10 device.

Thank you and best,
Pascale

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problem replicating model from Blandiardo text
parts:
Try upgrade to R 4.3 and use the most recent testing version 

That version use less memory.   If that does not run , that is the reason 

—
Haavard Rue

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Problem replicating model from Blandiardo text
parts:
For the Piemonte analysis, the issue is typically the size of the _model_, not the number of observations.  You can reduce the memory requirements by reducing the number of allowed parallel threads.

Finn
